problems: state-of-kuwait.json (written by me-10-k) duplicates the 1961-1991 stretch of kuwait.json, which reads Kuwait and State of Kuwait (Wikidata Q817) as one state and covers both Cliopatria Names; delete state-of-kuwait.json or make it a pointer, and give kuwait one hue (colours.json has #b85e31 for kuwait and #ca933e for state-of-kuwait).

bahrain is NOT merged with kingdom-of-bahrain: Cliopatria's Bahrain 1757-1782 is the Al Madhkur's Persian-dependent Bahrain (1753-1783) and its 1820-1845 shape (72,705 km2) is the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia, judged wrong. The continuous Bahraini state is house-of-khalifa (1783-1971, extended with 1800-1802 and 1895-1971 keyframes); kingdom-of-bahrain (me-10-l) should start in 1971 and share its hue.

Vassal, tributary and protectorate relations of Kuwait and Bahrain belong in the suzerains' ledgers (schema): ottoman-empire (Kuwait 1871, Basra Vilayet 1875), kingdom-of-great-britain (Kuwait 1899-1961, Bahrain 1861-1971), muhammad-ali-dynasty (Bahrain tribute c. 1830), emirate-of-nejd (Bahrain tribute 1843-1851); details in the notes file.

Page budget: zand-dynasty used 6 pages against up to 5 because the Zand dynasty page is a stub with no narrative and the Zand Iran page carries it; kuwait used 4 (budget 5, three more shapes merged in); bahrain 3 and house-of-khalifa 4 with three of the pages shared.

WebFetch returns a model extraction of each page, not its text; quotes in the notes are the excerpts it returned (some capped at 125 characters) and a few of its dates came with a 'context' caveat, those events are confidence 2. 13 distinct pages were opened in all; sources_total counts the 17 entries across the four dossiers.

Counterpart slugs used that are not Cliopatria rows of their own years: kingdom-of-iraq (1923 border, Cliopatria row 1932-1957), kingdom-of-saudi-arabia for the Neutral Zone from 1922 (the continuing state; Cliopatria row 1936-2024), emirate-of-nejd for Nejd in 1920 and 1851.
